result.rationale: The diff shows the EmailField is fully controlled: `value={field}` with `onChange` updating the parent array via setValue, so when an item is removed mid-list, every re-render passes the correct (shifted) array values to the inputs at each index. Since the displayed value is a prop, not internal state, index-based keys cannot cause stale input values; at most it could cause focus/selection quirks, not the 'stale input state' defect claimed.

record.issue_text: List items keyed by array index in MultiEmail.tsx:31, which can cause stale input state when removing an email from the middle

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/ui/form/MultiEmail.tsx`, the list renders `value.map((field, index) => ( <li key={index}> ... ))`. Since emails can be removed via `updatedValue.splice(index, 1)`, removing an item from the middle shifts subsequent indices/keys, which can cause React to reuse the wrong component instances (e.g., focus/validation/internal state in `EmailField`) and lead to stale/mismatched input state.
